purpose: Classify recovered R1-A concerns against later durable Prometeo authority without confusing conceptual convergence with R1-A provenance.

state_definitions.LATER_ADOPTED_UNATTRIBUTED: A later current/accepted/candidate owner embodies the concept, but no durable evidence proves the implementation was adopted from R1-A.
state_definitions.SCOPED_LATER_OWNER_R1A_CONTENT_UNKNOWN: A later scoped owner exists, while the original R1-A artifact/body for that concern is unavailable.
state_definitions.HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_ONLY: Recovered only as historical scope/requirement/rationale; no present authority effect.
state_definitions.UNRESOLVED_EXACT_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Cannot be resolved without authentic original R1-A source/evidence.
state_definitions.REJECTED_AS_AUTHORITY: R1-A must not own or override the current subsystem even if historically related.

rows.interpretation: Prometeo now has explicit Current/authority/lineage governance, but no durable edge proves those mechanisms were adopted from the missing R1-A artifacts.
The later system explicitly separates version lineage from capability champions and scoped acceptance; conceptual convergence is strong but R1-A provenance remains unproven.

rows.r1a_concern: DESIGN_KERNEL_DRAFT / COLOR / MATERIAL / TYPOGRAPHY / MOTION / CONTROL system drafts
rows.interpretation: R05/current shared owners now preserve authority-aware tactile/material/kernel laws. R05 itself explicitly classifies Design Kernel v2, Physical Material v2 and bicolor material as candidates/scoped owners rather than global Human Accepted truth. Missing R1-A drafts cannot be substituted with these later sources.
Later Prometeo has scoped touch/input/Exact Back/interaction ownership rules. They must be consumed from their current owners rather than recreated from missing R1-A matrices/contracts.
Later Classes runtime/product candidates have their own evidence and ownership. The missing R1-A experience synthesis cannot promote, replace or reinterpret them.
Later Student World runtime/product candidates have their own evidence and ownership. R1-A remains optional historical product-experience evidence only.

R07 now owns recovery knowledge for PageKit/Class Player/whiteboard while PageKit authority remains in scoped lineage/current owners. V26 rollback evidence and V37 capability-candidate evidence must not be collapsed into the unavailable R1-A synthesis.

Later recovery/current rules strongly reject flattening product-specific accepted behavior into one generic redesign. This is a valid present constraint, but not evidence that the exact R1-A rule body survived.
No exact A/B bodies, evaluation dimensions, evidence or winner were recovered. Later visual systems cannot be reverse-labeled as A, B or hybrid.
Later touch-first and consumer-specific rules are compatible with the historical concern, but there is insufficient exact evidence to claim the R1-A matrices were adopted.
Later lanes preserve concrete negative knowledge from durable evidence. Do not invent the missing R1-A disease/red-team entries or duplicate normalized current registers.

No missing historical repaired/spec proposal may be reconstructed and then presented as implementation authority. New implementation work must start from current owner evidence and explicit acceptance gates.
The checkpoint ledger cannot be upgraded to PASS, reconstructed, renumbered or mapped to later tests without the authoritative protocol source.
Preserve the historical pass report with its evidence ceiling; it cannot resolve the canonical checkpoint gap or prove overall R1-A completion.
The recovery lane must not manufacture the historical completion marker. The present RECOVERY and LAST_RETURN are new provenance-safe handoff artifacts for future agents.

summary.policy: Strong conceptual convergence may be recorded, but adoption/provenance remains unattributed unless exact durable lineage evidence is found.
summary.future_upgrade_rule: Authentic source discovery upgrades only the affected row after exact provenance verification; never bulk-promote R1-A.
